audit.why: content.win and CHAMP_FULL.phases both read as a coinflip lane with Cassiopeia edging the first item and beyond, which matches a 50.54% Emerald+ rate over 93 games. Sett has no dash and no range, she out-DPS-es any trade she is allowed to extend, and one landed Facebreaker still swings it — that is an even lane and both charts say so. No stage side needed changing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike names his R as a kill button but gives no cooldown, so "bait it" has no timeframe attached.
audit.why: The Show Stopper is 120/100/80 and Facebreaker 16/14.5/13/11.5/10. A baited ultimate is a two-minute window at rank 1 in which the only thing that reaches you is a 16s E, and that is the shape of the whole mid-game.
audit.corrected: 120s written into spikes[1].text; Facebreaker named by its real name throughout so the 16s is trackable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. (a) wants.you[0], mid and whys[5] tell you to ground Sett with Miasma — two of them in the same breath as calling him "the dash-less brute". Sett has no movement ability, so grounding removes nothing; the slow is the entire value of the cloud here. (b) wants.foe[0] and whys[0] call Facebreaker a "grab-stun pull". It only stuns if there are enemies on opposite sides of him; against a lone Cassiopeia it is a slow. That single conditional decides whether his all-in works. (c) spikes[3].text says Haymaker hits "true damage at max charge". The true damage is positional, not charge-gated — the centre band is always true, the sides are always physical.
audit.why: Riot: Facebreaker — "Sett pulls in all enemies on opposite sides of him, dealing damage and stunning them. If enemies were only on one side, they are slowed instead." Haymaker — "expends all stored Grit to gain a shield and punch an area, dealing true damage in the center and physical damage on the sides." Sett's kit file lists no dash. Miasma grounds movement abilities only.
audit.corrected: Grounding demoted to the slow, Facebreaker's both-sides condition stated, and Haymaker's centre band corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: Haymaker is a Grit-fed shield as well as a punch, and nothing tells you to empty the bar before trading — the entry mentions the W bar but never says the shield is what eats your burst.
audit.why: Riot: "Sett passively stores damage he takes as Grit. On cast, Sett expends all stored Grit to gain a shield." A full bar is a shield that swallows a Twin Fang chain; a spent one on an 18s cooldown is your window.
audit.corrected: Stated in mid — make him dump Grit on minions first.

edits.before: Sett's R yanks you in, suppresses, and slams for a kill — bait it, or hold your own R (Petrifying Gaze) to stun him out of the all-in the moment he lands.
edits.after: The Show Stopper carries and slams you for a kill on a 120s cooldown — bait it, or hold Petrifying Gaze to stun him out of the all-in as he lands.

edits.before: Sett goes tanky-bruiser and his E grab becomes a flat pick for his team — never facecheck alone, and respect his W smash hitting true damage at max charge.
edits.after: Sett goes tanky-bruiser and Facebreaker becomes a flat pick for his team — never facecheck alone, and respect that Haymaker's centre band is always true damage.

edits.before: Drop W (Miasma) on him to ground the dash-less brute so he can't reposition after whiffing his E grab
edits.after: Drop W (Miasma) on him for the slow — he has no dash to ground, and the slow is what keeps him out of E range

edits.before: Land E (the grab-stun pull) to drag you in and lock you for his double-punch and stored W smash
edits.after: Land Facebreaker (E) with a minion behind you so it stuns instead of slowing, then Haymaker

edits.before: Sett's level 1 is grit and his Pit Grit double-punch, but with no dash and no range he can only E-grab — sidestep it and you take the lane uncontested.
edits.after: Sett's level 1 is Grit and the Pit Grit punch alternation, but with no dash he only has Facebreaker — and alone it slows rather than stuns.

edits.before: Your first-item Liandry's plus Serpentine Grace move speed make you a kiting DPS that empties his W bar and grounds his repositioning with Miasma.
edits.after: Your first-item Liandry's plus Serpentine Grace make you a kiting DPS that empties his Grit bar and holds him back with Miasma's slow, not its ground.

edits.before: This is a true coinflip phase. You out-DPS him in any extended trade — Q to prime, then near-continuous Twin Fang — and your W (Miasma) grounds the dash-less brute so he can't reposition after committing. But at 6 his R suppress-slam is a free kill if he catches you, so the mid-game is about who lands their button first: hold W to ground his repositioning and save your own R (Petrifying Gaze) to stun him mid-all-in. Make him dump his W bar on minions, then trade; never fight into a full charge.
edits.after: This is a true coinflip phase. You out-DPS him in any extended trade — Q to prime, then near-continuous Twin Fang — and Miasma's slow keeps a dash-less brute walking, since he has no movement ability for the grounding to take. At 6 The Show Stopper is a free kill if he catches you, so it is about who lands their button: alone in lane his Facebreaker only slows, and it needs a target on your far side to stun. Save Petrifying Gaze for his commit and make him dump Grit on minions first.

notes: Riot's text for The Show Stopper says only that Sett "carries an enemy champion through the air and slams them into the ground" — it does not use the word suppression, so I removed the entry's "suppresses" claim rather than restate it. The kit flags the ability hardCC and grounding.
